# Auth Events Requirements Checklist: Auth events through the event port

**Purpose**: Judge the quality of the requirements for event recording, rollback and the live nudge
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Reviewer-owned; `[x]` means the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied, not that code is done.

## Event recording

- [x] CHK001 Are the new event's kind, subject, audience and payload stated exactly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is "the same transaction" made measurable by listing every write it covers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, US1 AS1]
- [x] CHK003 Is the payload's exclusion of secrets and other account fields written down? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Is the kind's place in the typed catalogue and its downstream readers (live hub, web) stated? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001, Plan "What does not change"]
- [x] CHK005 Are the specs it modifies (`257-FR-011`) and adds to the capability delta consistent with FR-001/FR-003? [Consistency, Spec "Spec Delta"]
- [x] CHK006 Is it explicit that the task's "Sign-in's own publish" means `SignInService.signOutEverywhere`, so no third flow is in scope? [Ambiguity, Spec Clarifications]

## Rollback

- [x] CHK007 Are all refusal paths (unknown, used, expired, concurrent, weak password, maintenance) enumerated with "no event"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, US1 AS2-3]
- [x] CHK008 Is the event-port failure outcome stated for the data (rollback of each write) and for the client (500)? [Completeness, Spec US1 AS4]
- [x] CHK009 Is the concurrent double save's outcome defined for both callers? [Edge Case, Spec US1 AS2]
- [x] CHK010 Is "the answer stays what it is today" bounded, given a 500 on port failure differs from the refusal answers? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002 vs US1 AS4]
- [x] CHK011 Is the admin-during-maintenance case, which completes, distinguished from the refused one? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Live nudge

- [x] CHK012 Is the nudge's timing (after commit, never when the transaction fails) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, US2 AS3]
- [x] CHK013 Is "once, through one method" objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, SC-002]
- [x] CHK014 Is publisher failure behaviour (logged, answer unchanged) defined? [Coverage, Spec US2 AS2]
- [x] CHK015 Is the order between the nudge and the e-mail stated as unspecified rather than left implicit? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK016 Is the accepted risk of a lost nudge justified and bounded? [Assumption, Spec Clarifications]
- [x] CHK017 Is the e-mail failure's effect on the reset and its event defined? [Exception, Spec Edge Cases]

## Scope and success

- [x] CHK018 Are unchanged surfaces (answer, e-mail, audit, openapi, web) listed so regressions are judgeable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, SC-003]
- [x] CHK019 Are the success criteria measurable without implementation detail? [Measurability, Spec SC-001..003]
